entries.5da4f3f2f7c07777: Through its proprietary method built on know-how from “RIZAP” and a low-price strategy, chocoZAP reached the largest membership in Japan within just 2 years of launch and achieved early profitability.
entries.66176316704411d9: The company has adopted the group philosophy of “Proving that ‘people can change.’” and takes the “self-actualization industry” as its business domain. As its long-term vision, it aims to become “a corporate group that contributes most to human health,” and aims to establish “chocoZAP,” its top-priority strategic business, as “social infrastructure for health.”
